R HOME / 09

COMFORT

Product photography as the central message.

VISUAL IDEA

Design,
assembled in volume.

The diagonal housing and flowing steam add movement to the static box. A graphite backdrop emphasises metallic details and highlights.

Two visible faces continue the same product story: a large front view, plus another angle and information on the side. White typography unifies the COMFORT series.
